data.name: Ghaaniyah
data.gender_notes: Ghaaniyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'ghana' meaning 'to vanquish' or 'to overcome'. In Islamic context, Ghaaniyah signifies a victorious or triumphant woman who overcomes life's challenges with courage and resilience. The name Ghaaniyah carries the meaning “Victorious, Triumphant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ghaaniyah usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious, triumphant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the spiritual victory and resilience of a believer in Islam.
data.etymology: Ghaaniyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious, Triumphant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ghaaniyah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
